reading: measured per generation: {"r7b": {"door_number_drops_when_a_label_is_added": false, "cells_total_with_label": 1, "cells_total_without_label": 1, "union_with_label": 1, "union_without_label": 1, "union_unchanged": true}, "r7b4": {"door_number_drops_when_a_label_is_added": true, "cells_total_with_label": 0, "cells_total_without_label": 1, "union_with_label": 1, "union_without_label": 1, "union_unchanged": true}}. Under r7b4 a same-file edit that only adds the provenance-label <span> takes `cells_total` (the number the door's growth arm compares) from 1 to 0 while the union of hits and attributed_in_fold stays at 1 -- the screen keeps every byte of wording. Under the door-pinned r7b the same edit moves nothing (its cells_total stays 1), because that generation honours no spread anchor, so the fold stays unanchored and the cell stays a hit. The re-filing face is therefore a property of the newer rulers: it appears the moment the door's pin moves there, which is exactly the move the ORD-0448 r7b5 repair would have made.
